summary: Installed the reviewed F02 All Saints three-document family (Claude, 1962). The artifact snapshot research/artifacts.json was current. `make install-doc PROVIDER=claude` ran for the bare ID, -synthesis and -homily with the normal recipes. No retypesetting was needed, and each build PDF and installed PDF equals its reviewed SHA-256: pdf/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints.pdf 08f8c5e99572d5f8a9584555c47b901bc32abd09fdf74dd5d7094f387143c3bc; pdf/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints-synthesis.pdf fb899d0258fe16641fb2be454eb088f37fd41011012fe599b5fb2d5ac397c881; pdf/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints-homily.pdf a6630b389583e729bbaa18103fb48364e2767d47485ecbddeb4ddbef4d3bc2ac. The reviewed Markdown was installed byte for byte at web/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints.md (cbe405ad17c9ba6be5d64d37891a282e99700df9a1ded3528ab595931cf0438c, equal to the build file and research/web-artifact.json). Staged paths, exactly one: web/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints.md cbe405ad17c9ba6be5d64d37891a282e99700df9a1ded3528ab595931cf0438c. The index held nothing before. Release records: the three release/publications/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/f02-all-saints{,-synthesis,-homily}.json records (a5ba83ab5bb6d180f5d1fe6e8268c5274f20a3a412c9341b4ab81c35a3b0767a, 4b1a573dd37de9a4523d17e5aadc50d7ead684a382a6a9a002b6c013422545ad, 5ded7baa46b06e84b53480c38ac4c640dad28e630c6035932b6edbee964e97b3) already carry the exact IDs, library/traditional-latin-mass.md, alpha and perpetual-public-repository-2026. `make add-publication` refused to overwrite them and they are unchanged. Catalog: the F02 row's Claude cell already links Full PDF, Synthesis PDF, Homily PDF and Read in manifest label order (complete / Full PDF), and the leaf's claude: publication marker is present. Neither was changed. The document catalogue was regenerated: src/web/data/structure/documents/corpus.json is now be98b54e5cde805f4ee17d039c8da4234b9270e867ffb24c4e3ab66e946dd809. The diff is confined to this leaf's entry and the aggregate counts. Release bindings were refreshed in two scoped runs. The first, `make refresh-release-bindings ONLY=...`, re-recorded corpus.json, the installed web Markdown, src/web/data/structure/sources/index.json and four changed edition JSONs. The second added ADOPT=1 for only the three new edition JSONs this run created: bernard-of-clairvaux sermones-in-festo-omnium-sanctorum, PL 183 and Summa prima q23. That leaves release/public-alpha.json at 20bbc328dc51261ba2a74de6cb137252caea240cfc1e32ee07d32d10b317e2bd. The tool also rewrote release/rights/public-alpha-2026-07-15.md (cb9f732fe8cc0fca76f5ae4ff7f4d9e3fcdf196c7ca65e3efebc2349de42d8bb) for the same paths. Production audit: an install-publication entry listing the engine's review results with their accepting result hashes and the installation facts was appended to research/production-review.md (cdd14a9a2bbd2731a072e11904f5e88c74d0f10518c490559a18427e68033698). Pre-checks, all passing: the publication-phase _proper_study.py check, make check-release-bindings (0 stale), the scoped tools/tpt public-alpha check, both document-library checks and make check-web-editions-current. The Claude publication inventory, the source-family ledger, the generation metadata and the revision timestamp were not touched. For the owner (no action needed for acceptance): add-publication has no preserve-if-identical path and exits nonzero on an existing correct record, and refresh-release-bindings rewrites the shared rights-record site-source table as part of a scoped refresh. This dispatch contributed the installation of the three reviewed PDFs and the canonical web edition, the scoped catalogue and release-binding refresh, and the production-audit record of the reviews and installation.
